stem:
Uma fries puris. Some puff well; others do not. She wants to investigate what makes a puri puff up.
A factor is something she can change that may change the result.

Which claims name possible factors? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The thickness of the rolled dough is a possible factor.
The temperature of the oil is a possible factor.
How much the puri puffs up in the hot oil is a possible factor she changes before frying.
The golden-brown colour of the fried puri is a possible factor she changes before frying.

teacher.key_rationale: Thickness of dough and oil temperature can be changed and may change puffing. How much it puffs and its colour are results, not factors she sets beforehand.
